'''Lord Frodo Jedi training!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lord Frodo]]
* '''Published:''' 8 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MWYHL Frodo LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I didn't invent it but I made it and I play it!

The published list has 57 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 57 as published: the headers total 60, but Vehicles (4) lists a single Snowspeeder, and Dagobah appears in both Starting and Locations (counted once).
* Posted 'DOS' dested Daughter Of Skywalker; 'Jedi Luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Obi's/Luke's/Ani's Stick' the matching lightsabers; 'Heavy Turbolaser' Heavy Turbolaser Battery; 'Lt. Blount' Lieutenant Blount; Wise Advice the Special Edition Effect.
